question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left midfielder, Bob is playing right midfielder, Claire is playing striker, Dave is playing center midfielder, Eve is playing benchwarmer, Fred is playing left winger, and Gertrude is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Dave and Fred trade positions. Then, Eve and Alice trade positions. Finally, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) left midfielder
(B) right midfielder
(C) striker
(D) center midfielder
(E) benchwarmer
(F) left winger
(G) right winger
solution:
Each row lists the positions of Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: left midfielder | right midfielder | striker | center midfielder | benchwarmer | left winger | right winger
1. Claire ↔ Gertrude: left midfielder | right midfielder | right winger | center midfielder | benchwarmer | left winger | striker
2. Dave ↔ Alice: center midfielder | right midfielder | right winger | left midfielder | benchwarmer | left winger | striker
3. Bob ↔ Claire: center midfielder | right winger | right midfielder | left midfielder | benchwarmer | left winger | striker
4. Eve ↔ Bob: center midfielder | benchwarmer | right midfielder | left midfielder | right winger | left winger | striker
5. Dave ↔ Fred: center midfielder | benchwarmer | right midfielder | left winger | right winger | left midfielder | striker
6. Eve ↔ Alice: right winger | benchwarmer | right midfielder | left winger | center midfielder | left midfielder | striker
7. Dave ↔ Gertrude: right winger | benchwarmer | right midfielder | striker | center midfielder | left midfielder | left winger
Alice is playing right winger, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
